trailhead.label: The centre of Colfosco, the board’s start

cautions: A steep climb over scree and rocky spurs to the Forcela Ciampëi: sure footing needed, for you and your dog.
High, open ground at 2,000–2,480 m with no shade: storms build quickly on summer afternoons.
About 1.9 km on tarmac at the start in Colfosco: keep your dog on a short lead.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
